title: Houston names 'the Hill', a telepathic chat room for non-speakers
summary: Ky Dickens tells of Houston names 'the Hill', a telepathic chat room for non-speakers, about c. 2023 at Atlanta, Georgia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: coined this term this the talk on the hill which was this telepathic chat room where non-speakers can tune in and communicate with each other

plain: Ky Dickens, a filmmaker who made a documentary about non-speaking children said to communicate by thought, says a young non-speaker named Houston in Atlanta, Georgia, coined a phrase around 2023: "the talk on the Hill". According to Dickens, the Hill is a kind of telepathic chat room, a shared mental space where non-speakers, including others she names as Akil, John Paul and Libby, tune in and talk with each other. If true, it would mean people who cannot speak are holding conversations by mind alone.
